summary:
Zoom EPS 1.42 美元暴超預期73%、營收年增5.5%，成本控管亮眼但成長動能溫和。
• EPS 1.42 美元，超預期 72.84%，獲利能力強勁
• 營收 12.4 億美元，年增 5.47%，企業端穩定
• AI Companion 等功能擴大產品價值與留存
• 本益比約14倍且現金充沛，估值偏低
ai_view:
訊號喜憂參半：EPS 暴超預期凸顯成本控管與獲利能力極強，但營收僅個位數成長，反映核心視訊市場已趨成熟。短期獲利驚喜或激勵股價，惟市場將追問成長引擎何在。約14倍本益比與淨現金部位提供下檔保護與回購空間。中期追蹤企業客戶留存、AI 變現、Phone/Contact Center 等新業務貢獻，以及營收能否重回加速。

需留意：營收成長僅個位數，疫後需求常態化後動能溫和；視訊會議市場競爭（Teams、Google Meet）激烈；獲利超預期幅度大恐含一次性因素，須觀察可持續性

summary_en:
Zoom crushed EPS at $1.42 by 73% with 5.5% revenue growth, on strong cost control amid modest top-line momentum.
• EPS of $1.42 beat by 72.84%, strong profitability
• Revenue of $1.24B grew 5.47% with stable enterprise demand
• Features like AI Companion expand product value and retention
• P/E of ~14x with ample cash; valuation is low

ai_view_en:
Mixed signal: the massive EPS beat highlights very strong cost control and profitability, but single-digit revenue growth reflects a maturing core video market. Near term the surprise may lift the stock, though the market will question the growth engine. A ~14x P/E and net cash provide downside protection and buyback capacity. Mid term, track enterprise retention, AI monetization, contribution from Phone/Contact Center, and whether revenue re-accelerates.

Watch：Single-digit revenue growth as post-pandemic demand normalizes; Intense competition from Teams and Google Meet; Large EPS beat may include one-offs; watch sustainability
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 暴超預期 72.84%，獲利大幅優於估計，惟營收年增僅 5.47% 偏溫和。
